integrity: The two original standalone checkers are embedded verbatim and can run without dependencies beyond Python 3 and a C++17 compiler.
scientific_limitations: Exact frame correspondence for the specified interaction axiom only; census for labelled total-order constructive-neighbourhood frames with arbitrary families including empty ones. title: Exact frame correspondence and labelled chain census for intuitionistic monotone possibility
